com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.datamodel

Class LDAITrackingTypes.MetricSummary

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.datamodel.LDAITrackingTypes.MetricSummary
  • Enclosing class:
    LDAITrackingTypes

    public static final class LDAITrackingTypes.MetricSummary
extends java.lang.Object
    A snapshot of all metrics tracked by a single LDAIConfigTracker.

    Returned by getSummary(). All fields are nullable — null indicates the corresponding metric has not been recorded yet. getSuccess() is a tri-state: null = not yet tracked, true = success was recorded, false = error was recorded.

    Instances are immutable.

      • getResumptionToken

        public java.lang.String getResumptionToken()
        Returns the resumption token for this tracker.

        Security note: resumption tokens embed flag-evaluation details such as the variation key and config version. Keep tokens server-side and do not round-trip them through untrusted clients where they could leak flag-targeting information.

        Returns:
        the resumption token, or null if not available
